answer: Each identity must anchor itself to one verifiable professional license, such as a bar or medical board credential, hashed once in the walnut register, with a 30 POA bond locked 90 days, renewed by a board-signed check each epoch. Each extra license from one funding cluster adds a delta of 15 POA, so bonds run 30, 45, 60 POA. 100 fakes need 100 real licenses, each taking years to earn, plus 3000 POA in bonds. Verifiers query the board registry each epoch; 2 failed renewal checks forfeit half the bond. Without a public registry, the board must countersign a letter; no self-claim enters.
